engineeringRecommendations.structure: One background organiser and reusable shared reader team agreed 27 October. Proposed standard implementation uses GUI QObject facade, coordinator thread, Qt worker pool and ordinary format parser functions; further detailed policies need check-ins.
engineeringRecommendations.concurrency: Max4 source-reading jobs total across PMR/MDB/required headers, organised by one background organiser/shared reader team, agreed 27 October. Organiser outside source-reader slots.
engineeringRecommendations.dispatch: Count dispatched through consumed completion; at most4 outstanding. Every task terminal completion exactly once; mutex/condition predicate loop; cancel wakes coordinator.
engineeringRecommendations.memory: Decisions3-4 agreed: raw buffers/parser workspace release after extraction; keep required compact facts until matching finishes then release. Measure the agreed design and report findings; no added RAM cap, database-size policy limit or automatic memory-based scheduling. Prior max4 source jobs stays; no measured Bella result exists yet.
engineeringRecommendations.ownership: Owned results, scoped file/buffer lifetime, no expired views or UI/parser mutation across workers.
engineeringRecommendations.selection: Coordinator-only matching/KelpieId allocation and source choice; deterministic row positions; no completion-order preference.
engineeringRecommendations.cancellation: Fresh atomic/generation each run, stop dispatch/open, cooperative checks and wake. Coordinator drains actual pool execution/cleanup off GUI. Coordinator finished notification alone is insufficient: require successful join before final publication/reuse, using nonblocking wait(0) readiness/defer on GUI. No active blocking GUI join. GUI generation/cancel check remains effective until acceptance.
engineeringRecommendations.shutdown: Decision6 agreed: preserve responsive Cancel and keep interface responsive through shared-reader cleanup/app closing; another scan/final destruction only after safe cleanup. Partial results stay. Blocked OS reads can delay completion; detailed API/lifetime choices still require review.
engineeringRecommendations.progress: Decision7 agreed: keep current event-driven progress, full warning/path details, diagnostic persistence and Console batching. No new200ms refresh timer, latest-snapshot coalescing, warning suppression/summaries or history cap. Later changes require another decision.
engineeringRecommendations.capture: Decision5 agreed: exclude/report a detected changed read, retain physical row and independently valid information, apply only approved fallbacks, leave fresh recapture to manual rescan. No automatic source retry. PMR DTM remains ignored and same-buffer set fallback unchanged. Exact check mechanism remains to specify.
engineeringRecommendations.presentation: Decision8 agreed: keep numeric displayed HH/MM/SS/FF Duration order, Kind ties for equal DISPLAY tuples and existing blank grouping. No elapsed-time key or lexical string sort. Earlier Bella zero-display corrections and exact timing interpretation remain; Duration display-label CSV convention unchanged by sorting. Earlier field exclusions/renames remain.
engineeringRecommendations.verification: Real output equivalence plus deliberate differences, parser corruption/bounds, task caps, reordered completion, cancellation/publication/lifetime, repeated scan memory, same-workload time/RSS/header-open/byte/GUI benchmarks.
engineeringRecommendations.conventions: Repository naming/formatting and explicit CMake source lists; clean warnings, pinned macOS/Windows builds, focused tests and available sanitizers; release performance measurements.
